prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: travel cultural story illustration triptych for an existing Chinese watercolor travel atlas website.
Primary request: one very wide landscape image, aspect ratio exactly 3:1, 3072x1024 or 1536x512, THREE equal SQUARE panels side-by-side, no gaps no borders. All same refined detailed transparent watercolor and colored-pencil journal style on warm ivory paper, pine and jade foliage with ochre accents. No text, no lettering, no signage, no UI, no watermark. Each panel's main scene in central square region.
LEFT: poetic evocation of Du Fu's Chengdu cottage environment, low traditional Chinese thatched cottage sheltered by bamboo and willow, narrow garden stream, light spring rain, a small empty writing desk with brush and paper in foreground. Architectural atmosphere not archaeological reconstruction. No person portraits.
MIDDLE: evocation of Xue Tao's literary legacy in Chengdu, slender bamboo grove, Chinese red wooden riverside memorial tower of Wangjianglou pavilion type in distance, foreground elegant small pink-red paper sheets with inkstone and brush, river mist. Memorial setting not claim of Tang dynasty original building. No people portraits.
RIGHT: evocation of Chengdu Wuhou Shrine cultural memory, long deep-red Chinese shrine wall, gray tile roof and ancient cypresses, foreground simple open traditional paper book with blank pages and feather fan, a calm historical atmosphere. No war scenes, no people portraits.
Constraints: authentic Sichuan/Chinese scenery, no Japanese torii. Fixed panel order. Beautiful balanced illustration detail. Match watercolor journal feel of an educational China travel anthology.
